reviews.text:
Worth the wait for the beautiful cross
Regards
Collinette Bakes
Easy to order and a quick delivery.

Seamless and easy shopping and checkout. Received the product and it was exactly as described and pictured. The name I had engraved is 7 letters so the engraving is quite small. Feels like good quality, not cheaply made. No metallic smell. No tarnishing. No green fingers. I love this.

I purchased these rings for myself and my granddaughters. The girls love that they can match grandma. When they miss grandma they rub their rings to feel better. Such beautiful rings at an affordable price.

I love the ring.  I do wish it was a little bigger because the words are very small.  
My husband when I would get stressed out would always tell me “Just Breathe” and now we are going through a difficult time in our lives with his health that when I feel stressed I look down on the ring I hear his words and see the words “Just Breathe” which calms me down.

The ring did come later than expected and so I thought at first I thought it was a scam especially because I saw this on IG But I did eventually receive the ring and I do love it.  It has a special place and meaning in my life.

So Thank You! 💕

Nothing but high praise for Hoperings , from ordering to receiving these most beautiful sentimental rings , this is my third ring now so so meaningful and comforting, I just love them , I’ve had many compliments and inquiries as to where I purchased them from , I’m about to purchase another 2 rings as gifts. You won’t be disappointed , a lovely caring little company ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️❤️
Website was user friendly, ring us exactly how was it described. Packaged with care. I would order again.

So far the experience with this company has not been straight forward or for that matter, satisfactory. First is that although the company is stated as being in the EU, manufacturing and supply comes from China. See where I'm heading with this? All the details and look of the website suggests in Europe but postal details only after purchase then indicate supply and shipping is from China. I ordered a ring for my partners birthday who is also suffering from a bereavement of a very close relative who past last week and this ring was intended to provide some degree of comfort through this emotional time for her. Placed the order on 6th June for her birthday on the 11th. It's now the 13th and the tracking says its not moved from where? since the 9th. Hope Rings also use Everi for shipping, possibly the worse carrier on the planet, need I say more. I would avoid Hope Rings at all cost. They are not what they first appear!
The ring is so meaningful for my dearest friend who is going through really hard times
My 10 year old Granddaughter loved it.  She promoted to the 6th grade and is a little scared to go to a new school!  She said she was going to rub it when she gets anxious!
It was on time and brought with care as well
My ring is beautifull as it is in memory of my brother i lost in february now i feel he will be with me when i wear it which brings me happyiness.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Excellent service and beautiful rings
I’m absolutely delighted with the rings I received—they are stunning and great quality. I did have a small issue with one of them, but when I contacted customer services, it was resolved quickly and without any hassle.
The communication was excellent throughout—very supportive and responsive. They kept me informed every step of the way, from what was being done to when my replacement was shipped, and they always replied to my emails promptly.
Overall, fantastic customer service and brilliant products. I would highly recommend Hoperings to anyone.
Thank you so much for your help and support!

I ordered the ring for my granddaughter who sometimes lets ther world get to noisey. She really likes it. I know you said the ring was one size fits most but I thought it looked a little smaller in size than expected. I didn't think it looked strong enough to try to enlarge it. My granddaughter loves the intent of the ring and was wearing it. She does not live near me so just got a report over the phone. I ordered the silver upgrade so I am hoping it will be a lifetime inspiration for her.
Easy ordering, quick shipping and a very nice product. Wife loves it!!

I purchased this ring for my granddaughter and was pleasantly surprised by how much she loved it. I upgraded to the silver ring in hopes that it would last longer for her to enjoy. Seeing the joy on her face when she read the little verse that's included with the ring really made my day. Thank you so much I found your product in Facebook on one of your ads and you reeled me in. I am so glad you did. 
Shipping was very fast I believe I received the ring in 5 days.

This ring has brought me comfort after losing my precious fur baby girl. It helps me to remember that she is always with me. I also like that it fits on any of my fingers and it's comfortable to wear.
I still have not received the graduation gift for my granddaughter!  I order a ring and a sunshine necklace,  she graduated a week ago!

Experience has been great. I have ordered myself one for my son and when I am sad, thinking of him, just missing him in general I rub my ring I also do the same for his thumbprint necklace (not bought here). It distracts me and helps ease my mind. Waiting for my other one I ordered for my best friend. Sent back and waiting for it to be engraved and sent back.

Before my husband died he saw the rings and said you need to get our daughter and grandaughter one before I die he passed away before they were delivered it did take a long time to get hear but they were very nice rings
They were graduation gifts and the young lady was very excited 😀 to receive them. Thank you, kathy

Really pleased with this ring. It looks & feels great. 
After cancer treatment my hands & fingers get achy & swollen so having an adjustable ring is essential …. & this one is perfect 👍🏻
Really pleased with my ring. It’s beautiful. It’s adjustable so you can get a perfect fit. Easy to fill with ashes. Would recommend
The shipping communication was a little less desirable but the ring is beautiful and love it. It looks exactly as described.
My niece loved it very much!  Needed the sentiment of it right now.  Nice ring!
My order was dispatched very promptly. I am delighted with the ring which is for my granddaughter.
The necklace I ordered was exactly what I was looking for. I have a pair of earring that I love, and was hoping to find a necklace to match! The necklace was perfect.
My granddaughter just loved it and got a lot of compliments on it.
The Hope Ring was delivered promptly. I heard about the rings in a very difficult time for our family and it was the perfect reminder to our daughter that everything will be alright.

The ring has bought much comfort to me since my husband passed. It helps me feel close to him. 
Delivery was as quoted. I normally only wear gold but because of the stones you can't tell it is silver next to my other rings.
Clear concise and reasonably priced website with excellent delivery
Very cute ring, came quickly and m my granddaughter loved it.
Ring was gifted. Thankyou for the excellent service
I bought these rings for my late partners sisters. They feel that their brother is with them and gives them comfort

Love the ring. In fact, I’ve given them as gifts and everyone loves them. 

Very beautiful! A+
The saying of the ring and what it means and really fits really well.
purchased as gift for granddaughter and she loved it..

This is the second ring I've bought from here and it probably won't be the last. The rings are made very well and the overall customer service is fantastic. I purchased the ring that says just breathe and I purchased the ring that says I am unbreakable. I wear one on each thumb, and they remind me daily that I am worth it.

I purchased 3 hope rings for myself and 2 sisters since we recently lost our mom.  She always finished a phone conversation with "Feel a Hug". I had this engraved on the inside of each ring, "Feel a Hug, Love Mom.  I upgraded to the Sterling Silver (which was a lot more money) and have been disappointed in how much they stretched.  My one sister lost hers on a trip, she must have got it caught on something and mine has bent so many times it is now cracked.  My sister and I have ordered the Stainless Steel rings to replace the Sterling Silver, as we love this ring in memory of our mom.  My other sister is going to put hers on a necklace and pray she doesn't loose hers.  I would not recommend letting people upgrade this to Sterling Silver.

I bought a ring from hope rings as a gift and to my suprise it was absolutly beautiful. My friend loves it and wears it all the time
I would recomend hope rings to everyone. Thier product is liget. I would also buy from them again
It’s just like it shows and they were helpful and nice with the tracking process! Best place to go!
I think the ring is beautiful! I got it for someone special that is dealing with cancer and will be giving it to her soon! Thank you!

A very close friend and work colleague of mine has been going through a tough time of it lately and I saw these hope rings and the message they conveyed was just the sort of thing I think she needed to hear from someone who cares a lot about her.  It's her birthday on Sunday (7th June) so today (Tuesday 2nd June) I arranged to meet her on her lunch break I gave her the box, she read the enclosed card and then placed the ring on her finger.  The beaming smile on her face made my heart sing with joy, and the hug she gave me filled me with warmth.  I had to stop myself from welling up. And the small handwritten note I put in with it let her know how much she means to me.  Thank you Hoperings.  Andy
Easy ordering and the shipping time was a lot shorter than expected.

Very disappointed on paw hug ring when it was ordered it was to be engraved with the names Charlie and Jax  .only reasoned I ordered that ring sentiment for my wife of her two service dogs . It asked me when I ordered what was to be engraved . Ive ordered 5 or 6 rings at this point all is great but very disappointed with this one for sure . Sorry paul
My beautiful hope ring arrived in memory of my boy Logan it is beautiful quality and arrived in a lovely box it fits well and people noticing it .. I’m thrilled with it …
Great Value..love that is is adjustable!

Quality was more than I expected. The ring hasn't changed colors or changed the color of my skin.
Excellent job with this. Love it.
Amazing never taking it of since I got it

My Aunt recently moved to an assisted living facility.  The experience was very difficult and full of intense emotions.  When I saw the hug ring, I instantly thought of her.  She received it and wept. She was so moved by the gesture and now wears it on her pinky finger.  She is a favorite aunt, and it means a great deal to me that              the gift of the ring made her so happy
Adaptable for any finger , nice designs

I absolutely love my dog paw ring! The quality of the pure silver ring is wonderful and the engraving is perfect. The turn-around time for customization and shipping was very fast, and the box  & presentation is top-notch. Thank you HopeRings!

Lovely ring, I chose the fish swimming against the tide for myself. It is a reminder to be strong and courageous in sad times. 
Well made, fits very well and arrived quickly.
I love the ring.
She loved it!  That’s all that matters. Thank you!
Whenever I look at the ring it reminds me that no matter whatever it is I am facing I can do it !
Exceptional service they did me very proud I was very disappointed at the beginning but these lovely people  made my day day by being so kind with My situation amazing 🤩

Easy, accessable website.
A little disappointed that the bracelet had been tied. Too small as it was fir the wrist it was intended for. Spent over 2hrs undoing the multiple knots.
My wife loves her hug ring
Beautiful rings. I love wearing it  & so  many people have commented on it.
Very nice ring - my granddaughter was delighted to receive it and I hope to re- order later for another granddaughter.

Brought the hugs from heaven ring for myself and couldn't be happier.
The quality of the ring is fantastic,the engraving  is a loveky touch, the service has been amazing from start to finish, the ring arrived quickly and well packaged in a lovely box.
Definitely recommend to family and friends and have ordered again with them.
Every day I smile when I see the rign on my finger..Thank you for this perfection.
Love the ring only thing is l lost the screw hoping that the jewelers can mix it or give me any ideas thank you
Love it a lot
I bought this ring as a gift for my Granddaughter and she was thrilled with it when I gave it to her.
I'm satisfied

An email review was sent before the ring arrived and when i voiced my concerns as to whether the ring would arrive, Jen responded very quickly and kindly to put my mind at ease. The ring has been delivered and it is very nicely made, very happy with the product and would buy again
Ring is very flimsy...my wife has ben wearing it and it longer round. Writing is very small and hard to read.
I bought 2 stainless steel and 1 sterling silver “Just Breathe” rings. One for me the others as gifts. My son’s funeral is soon and I need a reminder to breathe during this sorrowful time.

I am always a little off of a website. I felt comfortable.The website was very easy and user friendly. My daughter is six months pregnant, and I had planned on giving it to her in her eighth month. But suddenly she lost her job, and I felt like this was an ideal time to give it to her. She absolutely loves it and hasn't taken it off. Thank you for such a meaningful blessing!
This ring is exactly what it looked like in the picture!! Great quality fast shipping.. my grand daughter is gonna love it!!
The picture, description, quality, special packaging, and price were excellent. Treasure my purchase for myself to have my loved one with me at all times.
I have not received my order and I have wrote several times I wish to cancel the order .
Well before I had even seen the I fn love you rings on Facebook. I have been saying that exact phrase to my Queen. She fn loves it.
My Hope Ring is a heartfelt reminders of those no longer with us.   The experience of purchasing the ring was very smooth.
My wife loves it ,we recently put our lil guy Scout down after 16 years ,I had love u scout put in side of band ,shx really likes it
Very meaningful message behind the Hope Ring. Experience was satisfactory and would recommend to friends. Great quality, very unique and pretty.
Beautiful fits comfortably and love the gold fish swimming against the silver true meaning moving forward in a different path ! Love it

Awesome exactly what I ordered...I got it for my daughter, haven't had the chance to give it to her yet..but believe me when our paths cross again there will be complete joy..
Thank you
People from Hoperings were always very helpful when I had questions about the feather ring.

Had a great experience with this company. 
Ordering was easy
Delivery was on time
The matching rings I got for myself and my sister were perfect.
Definatly 5 stars 🌟

The description of the ring was just how I imagined it to be when it arrived.It is a lovely quality ring with inscription and I know my grandaughter will love it a long with the beautiful verse.
Delivery details were kept up to date.
The product was as described. The shipping information didn’t update until the date of delivery, so we didn’t know when it was going to arrive. Overall satisfied with the luster and quality.
The item arrived as described in a few weeks. It will be a Christmas gift.
I like it. It is a birthday gift for my granddaughter. August birthday.
Rings are very nice, arrived in nice packaging. Good reminder to Just Breathe. Delivered faster than expected.

Absolutely love my ring, so precious. Amazing customer service. Great value for money. Have recommended to family .
10/10
Beautiful ring and saying.  Easy ordering process for aging grandparents.  It was delivered SO QUICKLY!  Now I can look at my ring and know my beloved grandparents are thinking of me.
Ring was a gift for my granddaughter and she loved it. Beautiful design and great quality material. My fourth purchase from Hope Rings and never disappointed.
I love my heart memorial ring as I feel my is close to me
I love the ring, I got one of the urn rings.  My husband passed and he never wanted to go places so now he's in my ring and im going to take him places.

Although emailing you was difficult from the U K, when the bracelets arrived they were so beautiful, so well made, boxed amd just what I wanted for two very special sons, I would give my experience a 10!  Well worth the wait ❤️.

Superb product, fast delivery, reasonably priced and on top of that first rate customer service, everyone on the team went above and beyond to help me with any queries and put any concerns to rest within a day. Highly recommended.
I love the ring. It is very light and easy to make smaller or larger. I lost my husband in January to Alzheimer's. The ring reminds me to just breathe and it will okay.

I absolutely love this ring. I had to have my girl ( dog ) put to sleep three week's ago it was very sudden and such a shock. My husband bought my this pet ring with her name in it and it has made me feel like she is with me so thank you for selling these ring's. 
Thank you so much for your reply hoperings and reaching out to me it was a lovely reply and thank you for your support.
She loves the ring!
I love the ring

Little disappointed.  Thought the words
“Just Breathe “ would have been a little bigger, where people could see and be able to read it.    Looked like in the pictures the ring would have been bigger in size and bigger letters. 
2 of the rings I bought are for birthday gifts, one in July and other in August.  
I do feel embarrassed to give
Fast delivery... Great price... Good quality
Met expectations & delighted my spirit

My girlfriend loved it. 
Shipping and service was fast and great
Everything was so simple! Doing an upgrade and just placing the order. Delivery didn’t take too long either

I just purchased two more rings. They are the "Just Breathe" one for myself and one for My 79-year-old mother she loves it. She told me when she feels overwhelmed she looks at her ring and it reminds her to just breathe and relax.
I bought as a gift for a friend and she loved it. Quality was very good.
The bracelet we ordered is well made and lovely! Also we had questions and connected with customer service easily and they were prompt in responding. Very happy with our experience!

The Hope ring I received is exactly what I expected to get when I ordered them. It took a little longer to receive them then I expected but overall not excessively longer. I have purchased one for myself and one for my two daughters after my husband/ their father passed away and it has been a great comfort to me. I have only had the ring for a short time so we will see how well it holds up over time.
My daughters were delighted with their rings in memory of their dad who recently passed away they are absolutely beautiful

Products were delivered promptly and look great. I gifted my granddaughters as wellas friends and all welcomed their gifts.
Thank You
Peter

reviews.text: I really like the ring however if it was slightly thicker and the writing on it just a margin bigger would be perfect . It has helped me in the way I need it to as I can be bad for holding my breath with anxiety and it reminds me to breath
love my ring.
It was amazing my wife was blown away

I paid extra to be first in line processing ordering on April 30th to get by Mother's Day. My order was not delivered until May 19th. Then when I received my order, I only received one of the four items I ordered. I have reached out a couple times regarding this with no response. I would still like the rest of the items I ordered. SO far customer service has been non-existent. I am hoping that this problem will be handled properly.

For some reason I didn’t get the ring I ordered. I had boughten two rings, and got one of them I didn’t order. What I received was a “ JUST Breathe “ ring and not the fidjit ring I ordered. Wondering why? Thanks for listening! Sue Pond.
My granddaughters loved them

I received the sons bracelets I ordered but they were too big and I have been trying for over 6 months to return and order correct size. They are nice bracelets but their customer service is not good at all. It has been almost non existent.  I would like to get this order straightened out and then never deal with them again.

I Love the jewelry and the message’s are very touching,I have ordered 3 bracelets for my sons and son-in-law and I have ordered 6 rings for my daughter and my sisters.I simply Love all my purchases. They also come in sterling sliver.I want to thank all the people at Hoperings for their amazing Jewellery.

I love the message on the ring, however the only finger it fits and shows Just Breath, is my pinkie. The ring material is very flexible almost to the point of making it seem the ring will break when trying to expand it to fit other fingers. I’m very disappointed that I can’t wear it on other fingers but I do feel connected to the heartfelt message

I love it.
It certainly lives up to the reminder that on tough days or other days it's there like a God sitting on your finger always there to assist when U feel U cant .
This ring assists in the every day tasks and the tough days are made somewhat more easier.
The ring is exquisite my wife loves it my only concern was the ten waiting days to receive it
Beautiful ring, a lasting memory of my son. Delivery was quick. Thanks!

The bracelet that I purchased for my daughter is just as it was pictured on your site.
I am so looking forward to giving it to my daughter very soon.
I really like and know my great granddaughter will too.
Granddaughter wears it every day ... just received replacement as she lost first one on vacation in April !!!  Would highly recommend !!!
I love the ring. It fits well and is very comfortable to wear
When I tried to make it bigger, it lost its shape and is not wearable.

The ring was a gift for my granddaughter to calm her through exam.....alas the delivery was slower than expected and it did not arrive in time.
She was pleased with the thought and the ring but I was disappointed.
On reflection, I think I could have bought similar ring much cheaper via Amazon.
 Not clear that it was coming sloooowly from USA.
Once cleared by customs, the courier was good with frequent tracking updates and texts. 
It arrived safely on Sunday afternoon.
Beautiful ring!!! Packaging was great!!!! And delivery was excellent!!! Overall experience would definitely purchase more!!!!
Fabulous company!  Great customer service and beautiful rings.  I'll be back to buy more as gifts in the future.  Thank you!
I have received my lovely urn heart ring and necklace fast delivery

I ordered the wrap-around paws ring for our adult daughter who had to say goodbye last year to her first fur-baby (so far), after almost 12 years together. When she opened the box, a very warm smile appeared on her face and she quickly put the ring on her finger. The ring arrived fairly quickly, but definitely before Mother’s Day weekend which helped as she was headed in a different direction than myself. It was the perfect gift.

I bought this ring for my granddaughter as part of her graduation stuff. I love it💕 and I'm sure she will too. Beautiful and thank you. I shall peak in later on what your building next. Sending good wishes in your adventures. Thanks again. Bitzie
Product quality met my expectations. Ease of ordering, timely and accurate delivery made for a positive experience alround.

I was tricked into thinking I could get a different ring for $99. What i didn't know wsa that I was being charged $99 plus the price on the first ring . Then I tried to cancel the whole order and low and behold,that part of the website would not work and replies got ignored! Never ordering from here again and will not embarrass myself and recommend to anyone else.
Great items. Very meaningful. Recipients were truly grateful.
I liked the communication process. The product is good at a reasonable price
Excellent service, great quality product.
The ring with paws gave me happy memories until it slipped off my finger n now sadness

My husband loved his leather bracelet with special message in the box. 
Really lovely thank you 😊

First of all their customer service is exemplary. To me, that's where it all begins. Everyone is very pleasant and helpful.Their jewelry is beautifully made  and they have such a variety to choose from. They will assist you from start to finish if need be. When you receive your jewelry, it looks so much better than the photos you can't help but to smile. Their pieces are carefully made with love and care and I truly believe their intentions are to make their customers happy whatever it takes. If you're looking to buy a piece of jewelry for a loved one or a friend Hope is definitely the place to go. You will not be disapointed. I highly recommend Hope Rings if you want to make that special person in your life smile and feel loved.

The customer service was outstanding.  Helping me come up with a beautiful message to honor my wife to fit on the bracelet. Everyone was just so nice and wanted to make sure it was going to be exactly like I wanted it. It was made and shipped fast. I absolutely love the quality of this linked forever bracelet.   I put it on as soon as I got it. I hope others purchase this great quality bracelet as they will not be disappointed!! A great way to honor a love one. An excellent experience all the way around! :) Thank you!!
I did not get what I ordered.  Never use you again.
Easy to order. And fast delivery. They are beautiful . Mine were gifts for my granddaughters. Love them.
Very pleased with the heart necklace good quality and very pretty

This popped up in my FB, and I browsed the site.   Having just lost my husband, I thought the ring would be appropriate for our daughter.   I finally gave her the ring, and she just loved it...I purchased the silver ring, not the stainless steel.    I hope she gets many years of comfort out of it.
It’s beautiful my bf died the morning he asked me to marry him I waited 7 years to get this once it arrived I cried it was everything on my hard days he’s there this ring means the world to me
Excellent quality FAST shipping
Delivery was timely. Safe. And reasonably priced. Thanks, Hop!
Was an easy process to order and the ring came quick. The woman i got it for was extremely pleased with the ring.
I have just lost my little girl of nearly sixteen years, and it is some comfort to have her name in this lovely ring thank you.
The rings are something I say to my daughters…. Just Breathe.  They were perfect.
It’s more sentimental, I lost my Love of my Life 2 years this May. This husband and wife ring is now on my right ring finger with his memories and most importantly His Love
Beautiful. My daughter loved it,I would highly recommend.
Beautiful ring, well made
Good quality, prompt service and delivery, I would order from this company again. TY

Thought the company was in California but is apparently shipping from China and is taking much longer than told on the website. Will be late for the occasion I purchased it for. If I knew it was coming from China I would have added 2 weeks.
Ring was delivered in a timely manner/ is just as promised. (I do wish the ring was available in gold tho.)
I bought this ring for my granddaughter.  I know she likes it.  I gave it to her for her graduation.
it was good but i got one wrong ring that i wanted😅 but it did take awhile tho i mean i do live in AUS

I bought 5 rings. One for myself and the rest for my daughter and nieces. The one I got for my daughter started falling apart. So I contacted Hope rings. They immediately sent me back a replacement. I was very pleased with the response and will be buying from here again.

I gave my granddaughter the HUG silver ring for her college graduation.  She loved the ring.  She was very touched by the message on the card and liked the fact that it was adjustable.  The next time I saw her she was wearing it. 😁
I appreciated the thank you from your company after I purchased the ring.  I actually bought 3 rings from you and have yet to give the other 2 to my niece and other granddaughter.
I also like supporting small businesses like yours.
Best wishes for future success with your company.

Gave the ring to a friend of mine who is battling breast cancer. Not many good days for her the last few months with chemo treatments and side effects to the same. She loved the Hope Ring. Absolutely Loved the Message too. A great gift for many different situations.  This worked great for hers
My daughters loved them ever so much!
It is a beautiful ring. It fits beautifully. The wording is perfect. It doesn’t turn my finger green.

It was easy shopping and all arrived in good order. The ring is a gift for my daughter who just graduated. Not easy finding a job, still figuring things out and moving forward so the symbolism was on par for graduation and I believe the message is powerful.
My ring is so cool

I am writing this to let people know about my experience with this company. I had ordered a mom/daughter ring (that is beautiful) and within a couple of weeks, one of the stones fell out. I texted the company about this (not expecting much in this day and age). I immediately got a response back telling me to take a picture of the ring and send it back. I did so, and with no questions…just an apology, a new ring was in its way. I did not have to go through the hassle of returning the original. Who does that these days?? Amazing customer services, and beautiful meaningful rings. I have ordered 4 already and I’m sure there will be more to come. Amazing company!! 10/5😊👍💕

Shipped quickly and item as described....would really appreciate if it came in a simple little box, I'd be willing to pay a couple extran dollars. Having said that, this is a great way to be a positive force in someones life
It was delivered on time, it is a beautiful product that is special to a mother and daughter. Perfect gift for a new mom.
The ring is beautiful I order 1 silver and 1 gold and 2 gift bags. I only received the silver one but not the gold one

I don't like how small in size my two rings were. I was also upset to find the EXACT rings on TicTok for $8. 99
apiece! I could have saved SIXTY dollars.

The bracelets that I ordered for my daughters are beautiful and I'm very satisfied with the quality. I haven't given the bracelets to them yet since I purchased them for Mother's Day, but I'm excited for their reactions. I know they'll love them. 💕
My wife loved her paws hug ring. It gives her a little comfort when she is missing a dog that she loved dearly.

The silver was very thin on the ring and I’m afraid that if I manipulate any more, the ring will snap and break into two.  I really can’t recommend this ring to my friends. Sorry.  I was disappointed in the quality.

Information about my delivery updated, timescale could be improved. Which would be a great benefit to the client and sending out a 5 hour window for delivery is purely down to delivery route given to the unfortunate driver. I'm available for a chat. I worked for a major delivery and warehousing company.I looked after their 2 top contracts at my time there. Never a problem having someone from the outside looking in, or is there?.

Great from ordering to recieving, kept updated with the delivery reports! The ring is absolutely stunning my daughter absolutely loves it ❤️ she now has her nan with her everyday! The quality is excellent for the price! Very happy customer
